policy.title: Nano 101 — the full course
policy.description: Pay in TEACHER, or pay in XNO and let the page swap it into TEACHER for the seller. Either way your access is proven by a block, not by our database.

listings.unlock:
Welcome to Nano 101.

Lesson 0: the reason you are reading this is not that a server decided you could. It is that two blocks exist on your own account chain -- a payment, and a receipt that commits to this exact offer -- and anyone can check them. Delete our database and your access survives; compromise our server and it still cannot be handed to someone who did not pay.

policy.title: TEACHER only — no XNO accepted
policy.description: This seller wants the token and nothing else. XNO payers are auto-swapped on the AMM inside their own wallet; the seller is paid in TEACHER.

listings.unlock: Paid in TEACHER. The seller never touched XNO, and you never had to source the token in advance.
